caption: The drawing shows a single, symmetrical object that resembles a tall, ornate goblet or chalice with a lid and two vertical, rod-like elements emerging from the top. The main body of the object has a bulbous upper section that curves inward before flaring outward again to form a prominent base. The item is supported by a long, slender stem with two decorative bulges, and it rests on a wide, flared circular foot. The entire object is rendered in shades of gray with pencil, using shading to create the effect of light and shadow and to suggest a three-dimensional metallic or polished surface. The background is plain and unshaded, with a rectangular border framing the main image. In the lower right corner, there is a smaller, simplified line drawing of the same object within its own small rectangle. The paper background has a yellowish tint, and faint pencil marks are visible along the border edges.
